title: Opposing directions in blood metal mixtures and mortality in US adults
description: Analysis code for a pooled NHANES study (1999-2018, 10 cycles) examining associations of blood lead, cadmium and mercury (plus selenium and manganese) with all-cause and cardiovascular mortality, including survey-weighted single-metal Cox models, quantile g-computation with directional decomposition, restricted cubic splines, cause-specific and competing-risk analyses, delayed-entry and selection-bias characterisation, and extended sensitivity analyses.
